description: Returns one current entry from the official US, UK, EU or Canada sanctions list (Canada entity-only; Australia pending, not loaded yet) by list and exact id, with proof of the official file it came from. Use it after sanctions_search_entries or sanctions_list_changes gave you an id; use sanctions_search_entries to match a name and sanctions_list_changes to see why an entry was removed. Inputs: list (required: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu, ca or au) and id (required, 1 to 40 letters/digits/._-, e.g. RUS0849 on uk or 36 on ofac-sdn). Output: entry with names, aliases, programmes, countries, first_seen and last_changed, and proof (official file URL, SHA-256, source date). An unknown or removed id returns the error entry_not_listed. Reads stored snapshots refreshed about every 6 hours; a monitoring feed, not a real-time clearance decision. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

id.description: The listing's id on that list, e.g. 36 or RUS0849

list.description: The list Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu, ca, au; e.g. ofac-sdn.

name: sanctions_get_entry
title: Get one current sanctions entry
